$comment: ROSTER OF RECORD for Jamey's crew. Owned by Casey (RR), brain at */casey/. This file is the ONLY place crew facts are stored. The seat map in */CLAUDE.md, the seats list in */moot/moot.md, and the seatRoster in the public site are POINTERS, not copies: they name the roster and stop. Any seat that needs to know who exists reads THIS file. If anything disagrees with it, this file wins.
sync: */casey/sync-roster.sh  (copies master to the published copy and verifies)

field_guide.id: lowercase slug, unique, used for cross-references
field_guide.name: the handle Jamey calls them by
field_guide.emoji: one icon, unique across the crew
field_guide.description: what this member is for, in one line
field_guide.type: replicant = a seat with its own brain folder and continuity. ami = a drone or Mannie a seat puppets; no continuity of its own.
field_guide.engine: which model or tool actually runs it: Claude, ClaudeCLI, Cursor, Gemini, Grok, ChatGPT
field_guide.system: current star system, meaning the project it is posted to. A posting, not a home.
field_guide.brain: path to its memory folder in VR. AMIs have none by definition.
field_guide.last_contact: date of the last session with this member, YYYY-MM-DD
field_guide.last_contact_basis: how that date was established, so nobody mistakes a guess for a log

lineage.$comment: Whose clones these are, and the hard line between the fiction and the man.
lineage.author: Jamey (James H. McElveen III). Trey is to James H. McElveen III as Bob is to Dennis E. Taylor: Trey is the character, Jamey is the author. Jamey's name appears on the cover after the word 'by' and nowhere else in the fiction.
lineage.naming_rule: Seats are Trey's replicants, not Bob's. Dennis E. Taylor's family tree documents Bob's line and has no authority here. Pick a name for FIT, the way a Bob picks one: after something that means something. Record whether it is on Taylor's tree in the canon_bob field, so the drift is visible data instead of an accident.
